blocks.text: Angelica Panganiban, Eugene Domingo and Kaila Estrada are among the actresses who will headline director Antoinette Jadaone’s first slate of projects under her newly launched production outfit, Ilaya Ilaya. Deadline reported on Saturday, Sept. 26 about the launch of Jadaone’s Ilaya Ilaya. The director established the production company with longtime collaborator and producer Reign Anne De Guzman. The company said it aims to support Filipino stories, women-led narratives, underrepresented genres and filmmakers working outside traditional studio and festival funding structures. Panganiban is set to star in Jadaone’s dark comedy “Boldstar,” which marks the filmmaker’s return to directing. Bianca Balbuena is producing […]...
